title: I dag er det født dere en frelser

request.style: English, Lutheran Christmas chorale, a full congregation singing in unison with a bright festive pipe organ and church bells at the end, steady even notes, G major, warm and joyful, 3/4, 84 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The shepherds watched out in the fields
Their flock through all the night
An angel of the Lord appeared
And glory shone so bright

[Verse]
Do not be afraid, I bring you joy
Good news for all the earth
Today in David's town is born
A Savior, Christ the Lord

[Verse]
And this will be the sign for you
A baby wrapped and laid
Within a manger, and the host
Of heaven sang and praised

[Verse]
Glory to God in the highest
And peace on earth tonight
To those on whom his favor rests
Sing all, sing in the light
